mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(d.deduct_days), 0) FROM approval_document ad JOIN leave_request_day d ON d.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND d.company_id = ad.company_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.author_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ad.document_type = 'DOC_LEAVE' AND ad.status_code = 'IN_PROGRESS'

SELECT d.leave_date, d.leave_type, d.deduct_days FROM approval_document ad JOIN leave_request_day d ON d.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND d.company_id = ad.company_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.author_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ad.document_type = 'DOC_LEAVE' AND ad.status_code = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND d.leave_date >= TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND d.leave_date <= TO_DATE(#{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.insert:
SELECT sq_approval_document.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO approval_document (approval_document_id, company_id, author_employee_id, document_type, title, content, status_code, submitted_at) VALUES (#{approvalDocumentId}, #{companyId}, #{authorEmployeeId}, #{documentType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{statusCode}, CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP))
INSERT INTO approval_step (company_id, approval_document_id, step_no, approver_employee_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{approvalDocumentId}, #{stepNo}, #{approverEmployeeId})

INSERT INTO approval_history (company_id, approval_document_id, actor_account_id, action_code, before_status, after_status, opinion) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{approvalDocumentId}, #{actorAccountId}, #{actionCode}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{opinion})
INSERT INTO leave_request (approval_document_id, company_id, reason, requested_days) VALUES (#{approvalDocumentId}, #{companyId}, #{reason}, #{requestedDays})

INSERT INTO leave_request_day (company_id, approval_document_id, leave_date, leave_type, deduct_days) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{approvalDocumentId}, #{day.leaveDate}, #{day.leaveType}, #{day.deductDays})

INSERT INTO equipment_request (approval_document_id, company_id, branch_id, asset_type, quantity, purpose) VALUES (#{approvalDocumentId}, #{companyId}, #{branchId}, #{assetType}, #{quantity}, #{purpose})
mapper.select: SELECT er.asset_type, er.quantity, er.purpose FROM equipment_request er JOIN approval_document ad ON ad.approval_document_id = er.approval_document_id AND ad.company_id = er.company_id WHERE er.company_id = #{companyId} AND er.approval_document_id = #{approvalDocumentId} AND ad.document_type = 'DOC_EQUIPMENT' AND ad.status_code = 'APPROVED'
